outlet_description: For a sentimental and harmonious vibe, partake in our wide selection of international and local cuisine. Served à la carte or buffet, have a sumptuous feast while appreciating cultural performances that include music and dancing. Carrying on the theme of traditional Filipino dishes, the Heirloom section of our menu has always been a family favorite. For a more exciting and interactive setting for the guests, enjoy the buffet section with a live cooking station. Veranda is a Green Choice Philippines awardee.
schedule_note: NOTE: Schedule for buffet may change without prior notice.

outlet_description: For a blissful and breezy surrounding, you can find it at TĀZA Fresh Table. Taken from the Arabic word of Taza, the meaning of fresh in our dishes contains natural sources from our best local suppliers. For a gratifying taste in our servings, be ready to be relished by some of our garden-fresh cooked dishes. With a live cooking station, our staff makes sure our international cuisine is as organic as possible to your satisfying taste.

Underneath the remarkable Tudor-designed rooftop of Taal Vista Hotel in Tagaytay City is our classic lounge that comes with a wondrous view of Tagaytay. Read a page or two by the cozy fireplace as you enjoy the nightly entertainment of piano music played in the center. While you wait, enjoy our wide selection of beverages and some fine appetizers and desserts.
operating_hours: Sunday to Thursday 10:00 AM – 11:00 PM | Friday to Saturday 10:00 AM – 12:00 AM

outlet_description: For a taste of sweetness, stop by the hotel’s pastry shop. From tasteful desserts like Pan de Coco and Ensaymadas, to our Spanish-style Bangus in Corn Oil, you can bring home snack favorites to delight your loved ones.
operating_hours: Sunday to Thursday 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM | Friday – Sunday 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM

outlet_description: Welcome to ALTA Ridge Bar, your perfect spot to dine and unwind in Tagaytay’s cool breeze. Enjoy stunning city views while savoring grilled meats, fresh seafood, comforting favorites, and handcrafted drinks. From appetizers to desserts, plus a wide selection of cocktails and alcoholic beverages, there’s something for every palate.
